I used the thin-lens formula: 1/d1 + 1/d2 = 1/f, so f = d1·d2/(d1+d2) should stay constant. I did not run a fit or compare other candidate expressions, and the check below was done by hand.

The result is only partly consistent. Rows 4, 5, 9 and 11 all give f ≈ 18.0. The other rows range from about 14.4 to 25.9, so the expression is not conserved across the whole table. It is the best candidate I found, with low confidence.
